paragraphs.text: 1. TURN, go not farther on your way: visit us, O ye Wealthy Ones.
Agni and Soma, ye who bring riches again, secure us wealth.
2. Make these return to us again, bring them beside us once again.
paragraphs.original: पुनरेना नि वर्तय पुनरेना न्या कुरु ।
paragraphs.translit: punarenā ni vartaya punarenā nyā kuru |

paragraphs.text: May. Indra give them back to us, and Agni drive them hither-ward.
3. Let them return to us again: under this herdsman let them feed.
Do thou, O Agni, keep them here, and let the wealth we have remain.
paragraphs.original: इहैवाग्ने नि धारयेह तिष्ठतु या रयिः
paragraphs.translit: ihaivāgne ni dhārayeha tiṣṭhatu yā rayiḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. 1 call upon their herdsman, him who knoweth well their coming nigh,
Their parting and their home-return, and watcheth their approach and rest.
paragraphs.original: आवर्तनं निवर्तनं यो गोपा अपि तं हुवे
paragraphs.translit: āvartanaṃ nivartanaṃ yo gopā api taṃ huve

paragraphs.text: 5. Yea, let the herdsman, too, return, who marketh well their driving-forth;
Marketh their wandering away, their turning back and coming home.
6. Home-leader, lead them home to us; Indra, restore to us our kine:
paragraphs.original: आ निवर्त नि वर्तय पुनर्न इन्द्र गा देहि ।
paragraphs.translit: ā nivarta ni vartaya punarna indra gā dehi |

paragraphs.text: We will rejoice in them alive.
7. 1 offer you on every side butter and milk and strengthening food.
paragraphs.original: परि वो विश्वतो दध ऊर्जा घृतेन पयसा ।
paragraphs.translit: pari vo viśvato dadha ūrjā ghṛtena payasā |

paragraphs.text: May all the Holy Deities pour down on us a flood of wealth.
paragraphs.original: ये देवाः के च यज्ञियास्ते रय्या सं सृजन्तु नः
paragraphs.translit: ye devāḥ ke ca yajñiyāste rayyā saṃ sṛjantu naḥ

paragraphs.text: 8. O thou Home-leader, lead them home, restore them thou who bringest home.
paragraphs.original: आ निवर्तन वर्तय नि निवर्तन वर्तय ।
paragraphs.translit: ā nivartana vartaya ni nivartana vartaya |

paragraphs.text: Four are the quarters of the earth; from these bring back to us our kine,
